cc:Work.dc:title: RTX 5090 · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · one pod
cc:Work.dc:description: On one RTX 5090 the AX tree leads stock vLLM DFlash2 on every workload at one and two requests (+59/+49/+8% and +32/+22/+5%).
